name: TodayTix
description: TodayTix theatre discovery and availability: the cities the site sells in, show search by city, keyword, date, price and sort, show detail with event-level low prices and publicly disclosed Rush/Lottery information, per-performance ticket snapshots with price bands and seat counts, and venue profiles. Read-only; no holds, lotteries or checkout.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: First hop of discovery: resolve a city name to a TodayTix location id, timezone and currency.

response.about: List the cities TodayTix sells in (content-service /api/v3/locations): id, seo name, country, currency, timezone, coordinates, whether displayed prices include fees, and the city's all-shows page. Use the id as location_id in search_shows.

fields.about: Public all-shows listing page for the city.

fields.name: country_code
fields.about: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (`regionCode`).

fields.name: entry_id

fields.name: id

fields.name: includes_fees
fields.about: The site's `includeFees` display setting for the city.

fields.name: seo_name

fields.name: timezone

tools.name: Search shows
tools.description: Find shows by city, keyword or date, then pass a show id to show or showtimes.

options.name: date
options.about: Only shows with a performance on this local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: limit
options.about: Shows per page.

options.name: location_id
options.about: TodayTix city id from locations (1 New York, 2 London, 3 Chicago, 4 SF Bay Area, 5 Los Angeles, 6 Washington DC, 7 Boston, 17 Sydney, 18 Melbourne, 19 Brisbane, 93 Perth, 95 Adelaide).

options.name: max_price
options.about: Only shows whose lowest regular price is at most this amount in the city's currency.

options.name: offset
options.about: 0-based offset; use next_offset from the previous page.

options.name: query
options.about: Keyword matched against show names (e.g. `hamilton`). Omit to browse the whole city.

options.name: sort_by
options.about: `price` (lowest regular price) or `recent_views` (recently viewed); omitted, the site orders by popularity.

options.name: sort_order
options.about: Direction for sort_by; the site's default when omitted.

options.name: timezone
options.about: IANA timezone the `date` is in. Defaults to the city's timezone for the known location ids; required with `date` for any other id.

response.about: Discover shows in a TodayTix city (api.todaytix.com /api/v2/shows, fieldset SHOW_SUMMARY): optional keyword, performance date, price cap and sort. Each card carries the stable show id, venue, run dates, event-level low prices (regular, rush, lottery; fee inclusion unknown), availability flags, promotion and review summary. Offset pagination with the site's total.

fields.name: end_date

fields.name: id

fields.name: location_id

fields.name: location_seo_name
fields.about: City URL prefix, e.g. `nyc`, `london`.

fields.name: name
fields.about: Full listing name, e.g. `& Juliet on Broadway`.

fields.name: on_sale_date
fields.about: ISO timestamp the site started selling.

fields.name: product_type
fields.about: SHOW, or other product kinds the site lists (e.g. gift cards).

fields.name: promotion
fields.about: Current site-wide or show promotion, or null.

fields.name: review_summary
fields.about: Show-Score style audience summary, or null.

tools.name: Showtimes
tools.description: Availability and prices per performance for a show id; filter by date window to keep pages small.

options.name: date_from
options.about: Keep performances on or after this local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: date_to
options.about: Keep performances on or before this local date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: include_no_inventory
options.about: Also list performances the site reports without any tickets (default true); false asks the site for performances with inventory only.

options.name: limit
options.about: Performances per page.

options.name: offset
options.about: 0-based offset into the (date-filtered) list; use next_offset.

options.name: show_id
options.about: Numeric TodayTix show id (from search_shows or the show page URL /{region}/shows/{id}-{slug}). Exactly one of show_id or url.

options.name: url
options.about: A todaytix.com show page URL instead of show_id.

response.about: Performance list for one show (api.todaytix.com /api/v2/shows/{id}/showtimes?includeNoInventory=true): every scheduled performance with local date/time and UTC offset, per-performance regular ticket snapshot (lowest price, face value, seat counts, price bands, sale cut-off), disclosed Lottery and Rush windows, and cast notices. Prices are per ticket as displayed; fee inclusion is not stated by the site. Optional date window and offset pagination over the site's full list. Seat-level sections are not available (AWS WAF bot control).

fields.name: datetime
fields.about: Local start time with UTC offset, e.g. `2026-09-22T19:00:00.000-04:00`.

fields.name: daypart
fields.about: MATINEE or EVENING.

fields.name: epoch
fields.about: Start time as Unix seconds.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Showtime (performance) id.

fields.name: local_date
fields.about: YYYY-MM-DD in the venue's timezone.

fields.name: local_time
fields.about: HH:MM in the venue's timezone.

fields.name: lottery_tickets
fields.about: Lottery window disclosed for the performance (read-only; entering requires the app and a login), or null.

fields.name: regular_tickets
fields.about: Regular (primary) ticket inventory for the performance; null when the site reports none (`regularTickets: null`).

fields.name: rush_tickets
fields.about: Rush inventory disclosed for the performance, or null.

fields.name: special_performance_info
fields.about: Cast changes and other notices for this performance.

fields.name: status
fields.about: `available` when any ticket type is on sale for this performance, `no_inventory` when the site lists it with no regular, rush or lottery tickets (sold out, not yet on sale or off sale; the site does not say which).

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: Where a show plays: pass venue.slug from a show card, or a todaytix.com venue URL.

options.name: location_id
options.about: TodayTix city id the venue is listed under (defaults to 1, New York; London venues need 2, etc.). Used for the region prefix of `url` and the site's `location` parameter.

options.name: url
options.about: A todaytix.com venue page URL, https://www.todaytix.com/{region}/venues/{slug}, instead of venue_slug.

options.name: venue_slug
options.about: Venue slug, e.g. `stephen-sondheim-theatre` (venue.slug from search_shows/show, or the last segment of /{region}/venues/{slug}). Exactly one of venue_slug or url. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

response.about: Venue profile by slug or page URL (content-service /api/v3/venues/{slug}): name, type, area, address with country code and coordinates, capacity, accessibility, transport, images and seating chart images, and the TodayTix city it belongs to.

fields.name: area
fields.about: e.g. `Broadway`, `West End`.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Venue id as the site sends it (numeric string), matches show venue.id.

fields.name: location
fields.about: The TodayTix city the venue belongs to, or null.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix milliseconds when this program read the source (SDK observation stamp).

fields.name: seat_plan_urls

response.description:
The Stephen Sondheim Theatre is a treasured gem within the heart of New York City. Located in the bustling Times Square district, it stands proudly, retaining its historical charm midst contemporary edifices. The theatre, formerly known as Henry Miller's Theatre, is deeply rooted in theatrical history, having hosted numerous Broadway classics since its inception in 1918. It boasts art nouveau architecture bathed in gentle, welcoming lights, with intricate details that add to its grandeur. A walk inside reveals a relaxing ambiance with ornamented ceilings, beautiful chandeliers, red velvet seats, and a sizeable stage that brings performances to life. Dedicated to the legendary composer Stephen Sondheim, the theatre's rich legacy continues by staging some of the most critically acclaimed plays, musicals, and performances, all enjoyed from the comfort of its 1,055 seats. 

**How to Get There** 
Stephen Sondheim Theatre is conveniently located at 124 West 43rd Street, accessible via various modes of transportation. Visitors can reach the theatre by subway, taking the B, D, F, or M train to 42nd Street/Bryant Park or the 1, 2, 3, 7, N, Q, R, S, or W train to Times Square/42nd Street. Buses M5, M7, M20, M42, or M104 also offer routes to Times Square. For those who prefer driving, several paid parking garages are available nearby.
